name: video_download
description: Download a video (or audio) from a URL using yt-dlp. Supports YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, and most other sites yt-dlp handles.

output.description: Output directory (default: ./downloads) or a full file path to save to.

format.description: yt-dlp format selector. Default: bestvideo+bestaudio/best. e.g. '133', 'best[height<=720]'. Ignored when audio=true.

audio.description: If true, download audio only as mp3 (192kbps). Default false.

list.description: If true, list available formats and exit without downloading.

title.description: Custom output filename (without extension). Overrides the video's own title.

no_playlist.description: If true, download only the single video, not the whole playlist. Default false.
